main:10.text: Mall Shootout is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by retired army colonel Juan Cortez from his yacht docked in Ocean Bay Marina in Ocean Beach, Vice City. Cortez hires Tommy to meet a courier, Pierre La Ponce, in the Washington Mall and retrieve some guidance chips that La Ponce should be delivering.

collectible:2.page: Rampages in GTA Vice City Stories
collectible:2.text: Rampages are challenges started via collectibles in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories. There are a total of 30 Rampages (35 Rampages in the PlayStation 2 version) located all around Vice City, appearing as a rotating white skull pickup item, which the player must find and collect while on foot and not in an active mission to trigger the challenge.
